requirement.summary: Block add item, delete item, Paid, and Print and Pay on a fully paid check
requirement.description:
After a check is fully paid, the user can still add an item, delete an item, or run Paid or Print and Pay due to UI out-sync. Saving that change can damage the paid check and cause an integrity error.

A check that is only partly paid can still be changed and paid. The block applies when the check is fully paid.

What to change

On a fully paid check, stop these actions and show "check is already paid":

- Add item, including from the menu, item code, barcode, and item search

- Delete item, delete last item, delete whole last item, and delete multiple items

- Paid

- Print and Paid

These existing flows stay available:

- Split revenue on a paid check can still add and remove the split items, then save

- Direct refund can still refund selected items from a paid check

- Release payment, void paid check, adjust payment, print paid check, and add or edit paid check info

- After release payment, the check can be changed and paid again

Acceptance criteria

- Adding or deleting an item on a fully paid check is stopped, with the message "Check is already paid".

- Paid and Print and Pay on a fully paid check are stopped with the same message.

- A partly paid check can still be changed and paid.

- Split revenue and direct refund on a paid check still work.

- After release payment, the check can be changed and paid again.

requirement.summary: HKJC - TMS - Update the Get Timeslot API to add several fields for Staggered Booking - Dev
requirement.description:
20260910 updated:

Additional requirement added:

- Retrieve and return next reservation start time (next_resv_start_time) for each available table. IF NO next reservation, THEN return period end time.

- Return reservation duration with cleaning time (duration_with_cleaning_time) for each table size. **

20260907 updated:

Question:

1, Should apply to Race day or 7 day ?

[Project] Only apply to 7 day.

2, Which Reservation Status should included in this case? eg. should No Show count ?

[Project] Since [No Show] should appear after Target booking time. So this can be ignore.

Since [Canceled Reservation] will release the Table, this case can also be ignore.

*For only 1 [Canceled Reservation] before the target booking time, the expected return last_resv_end_time should be the same as the period start time.

3, API confirmation edit

Background

Currently the Get Timeslot API for INSW only returns free tables without indicating when each table’s previous reservation ends (including cleaning time), so INSW can only assign tables according to table number. This leads to less optimal table utilization.

To improve table utilization when using staggered booking, the system needs to know when each table becomes free so it can assign the available table with closest last reservation end time to the target booking time.

E.g. Target booking time is 13:00.

| Table
| Last Reservation End Time

| 101
| 12:45

| 102
| 13:00

As-is: System will assign Table 101 first. But if later another member wants to book 12:45, there will be no option.

Expected: System should assign the table with closest last reservation end time to the target booking time, which is Table 102, so that Table 101 can be available for possible 12:45 booking, maximizing utilities.

TBL need to provide last reservation end time to INSW, who will assign the best table according to the above logic.

Requirement

Update the existing [GET] Get Timeslot API response for staggered booking to include the new fields "duration_with_cleaning_time", "last_resv_end_time" (including cleaning time) and "next_resv_start_time"  for every available table under each timeslot.

Take the last reservation end time right BEFORE the timeslot ONLY (or equal to timeslot start time).

(If no last reservation BEFORE the timeslot, return period start time as last_resv_end_time.)

Take the next reservation start time right AFTER the timeslot ONLY (or equal to timeslot end time).

(If NO next reservation AFTER the timeslot, return period end time as next_resv_start_time.)

Example response structure:

{
"status": "success",
"data": {
"periods": [
{
"period_code": 2,
"period_name_en": "Lunch",
"timeslots": [],
"tables": [],
"timeslots_tables": [
{
"timeslot": "13:00",
"status": "available",
"tables": [
{
"table_no": "1",
"capacity": 4,
"last_resv_end_time": "12:45", // <-- NEW FIELD (include cleaning time)
"next_resv_start_time": "15:45" // <-- NEW FIELD
},
{
"table_no": "2",
"capacity": 4,
"last_resv_end_time": "12:45", // <-- NEW FIELD (include cleaning time)
"next_resv_start_time": "15:00" // <-- NEW FIELD
}
]
}
],
"reservation_duration": [
{
"table_size": 2,
"duration": 90,
"duration_with_cleaning_time": 105 // <-- NEW FIELD
},
{
"table_size": 4,
"duration": 90,
"duration_with_cleaning_time": 105 // <-- NEW FIELD
},
{
"table_size": 6,
"duration": 120,
"duration_with_cleaning_time": 135 // <-- NEW FIELD
},
{
"table_size": 8,
"duration": 150,
"duration_with_cleaning_time": 165 // <-- NEW FIELD
}
]
}
]
}
}
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancement: [Jira-68358] HKJC - TMS - Update the Get Timeslot API to add several fields for Staggered Booking - Dev
Description:
Enhanced existing Open API: GET /rest_api/hkjc/shops/{shop_code}/outlets/{outlet_code}/periods (get_shops_outlets_periods) for 7-day outlets under staggered (multi-reservation) booking.
When staggered booking applies:
timeslots_tables[].tables[] adds last_resv_end_time and next_resv_start_time (HH:mm).
reservation_duration[] adds duration_with_cleaning_time per table_size (minutes, includes cleaning).
Setup:
Table Management System> Other Settings> Config by Location, set Multi-Reservation Validation Start Date
Table Management System> Basic Setup> Period Sets, set Cleaning Time, Last Arrival Time and Max Reservations Per Arrival Time
Sample request: GET /rest_api/hkjc/shops/{shop_code}/outlets/{outlet_code}/periods?date=2026-10-21&languages=en
Header: secretkey: <valid Open API key>
timeslots_tables (staggered mode)
For each available table in a timeslot: last_resv_end_time is the latest end time (book_time + occupancy minutes) of prior reservations on that table ending on or before the timeslot arrival.
If none reservations , period start time is used. next_resv_start_time is the earliest later book_time on that table after the timeslot arrival
Last/next includes completed reservations and excludes no-show and cancelled.
Each reservation_duration entry contains table_size, duration (dining minutes excluding cleaning), and duration_with_cleaning_time
If Multi-Reservation Status is Suspended
Scenario 1: Time status exceeding Last Arrival Time is Full
Scenario 2: When resv_number is supplied, that reservation is ignored for per-timeslot quota counting and table occupancy removal, so the member can see the same table/slot while modifying the booking.
If params has resv_number
In this case, if resv_number and other reservations are in the same table, then this table will not be displayed in the available tables
